title: Agente De Negócios - Representante Comercial Pj | São Lourenço - Mg
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina. Com soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente, com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Contamos com o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios e o iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre na vanguarda, com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.


Seu Cardápio Diário

Nesta posição, você será o ponto de conexão entre o iFood e novos parceiros de negócios. Seu dia a dia será guiado por estratégias de expansão, conquistando novos clientes em áreas com grande potencial de crescimento.


Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá:

  • Prospecção de novos parceiros: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e atrair restaurantes e estabelecimentos para o ecossistema iFood.
  • Gestão de funil de vendas: Realizar acompanhamento detalhado do pipeline, assegurando a conversão em cada etapa.
  • Acompanhamento contínuo: Manter contatos regulares e estruturados com potenciais clientes para estreitar relacionamentos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento: Ser referência no atendimento às demandas dos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência incrível desde o início.
  • Colaboração estratégica: Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time para maximizar resultados e impulsionar a presença do iFood na cidade de São Lourenço - MG .


Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de São Lourenço - MG ou das cidades de Itatiaia - RJ ou Cachoeira Paulista - SP e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.


Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.


Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood


Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

title: Analista De Rh
description:
Tem paixão pela área de Recursos Humanos e procura uma oportunidade para crescer e fazer a diferença?

Se considera uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e deseja desenvolver carreira em uma empresa dinâmica, em constante evolução?

Então essa oportunidade é para você!

Junte-se à nossa equipe e contribua para criar um ambiente de trabalho ainda mais humano e eficiente!

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico (BP) junto às lideranças das áreas, apoiando na tomada de decisões relacionadas à gestão de pessoas.
  • Atendimento e suporte aos colaboradores em temas relacionados ao RH.
  • Análise de dados e construção de relatórios de Jornada / Banco de Horas;
  • Condução de processos admissionais e demissionais .
  • Apoio no desenvolvimento de ações de formação, capacitação e clima organizacional .
  • Colaboração na implementação de políticas internas , cultura e práticas de RH.
  • Comunicação organizacional : promover e apoiar ações que fortaleçam o engajamento interno.
  • Gestão de benefícios, férias, ponto eletrônico e documentação dos colaboradores.
  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de relatórios e indicadores de RH .
  • Organização e controle de arquivos físicos e digitais.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Gestão de RH, Administração ou afins.
  • Vivência com os subsistemas de RH / DP.
  • Boa comunicação, escuta ativa e facilidade de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Organização, proatividade e perfil analítico.
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office.

O que valorizamos:

Aqui, todo conhecimento é valorizado.

A atuação anterior como BP pode ser um diferencial, mas acreditamos ainda mais no potencial das pessoas e em seus atributos comportamentais , como empatia, senso de dono, visão estratégica e colaboração.

Aguardamos sua inscrição e esperamos te conhecer em breve!

Juntos, podemos construir um RH mais próximo, estratégico e humano.

  • Visão Estratégica e Capacidade de Articulação : Perfil consultivo e integrador, com habilidade para interpretar e traduzir complexidades do negócio em ações e oportunidades de alto impacto, conectando diferentes áreas e promovendo uma visão unificada.

title: Advogado Pleno | Jurídico Tributário
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.


A área de Contencioso Tributário é responsável por gerir os processos administrativos e judiciais da companhia. Seu principal desafio é analisar autos de infração e execuções fiscais, garantindo o controle de prazos e o acompanhamento das ações. Também atua em parceria com escritórios externos perante os diversos órgãos julgadores do país, dá suporte a auditorias internas e externas e realiza o mapeamento dos riscos tributários decorrentes desses processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:


  • Analisar e interpretar legislações tributárias federais, estaduais e municipais;
  • Acompanhar processos administrativos e judiciais tributários;
  • Realizar o controle de prazos processuais, garantindo cumprimento dentro dos limites legais;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas, como contabilidade e financeiro para garantir conformidade fiscal;
  • Atender às solicitações da auditoria interna, externa e da governança corporativa;
  • Efetuar o mapeamento e análise de riscos tributários decorrentes das demandas em andamento;
  • Interagir com escritórios de advocacia externos para revisão de defesas, discussão de teses, estratégias e riscos processuais.


Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:


  • Formação Superior Completa em Direito;
  • OAB Ativa;
  • Conhecimento Sólido em Direito Tributário;
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em Direito Tributário.


Será um diferencial, caso você tenha:


  • Domínio intermediário/avançado de Excel;
  • Conhecimento deSAP;
  • Passagem por empresas de auditoria ou consultorias tributárias.


OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.


Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:


Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.


Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ.


Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!


Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.


Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma;
priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias;
valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .


Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

** you will need to have fluency in English.


About the Company


  • My client is a $100m private investment fund that specialises in the medical aesthetics industry and has a network of warehouses globally that serve as local procurement centres which source and ship products to global customers
  • The customer tends to be small - medium size health care professionals such as cosmetic, plastic & derma surgeons as well as Aesthetics GPs.
  • In essence, my client is a B2B distributor of medical devices & medical aesthetics products like botox and derma fillers
  • They have a presence in over 13 countries and have the majority share of 15+ businesses that specialise in medical aesthetic (B2B) distribution - ecommerce (B2C) and on ground selling to clinics (B2B)


About the Need:


  • My client is looking for a consultant, or someone that they will work with on a contractual basis (you won't be an employee) who already has an existent business set up, in selling medical aesthetics (specifically dermal fillers and Botox injectables) into Health Care Practises / Beauty Salons / Clinics in Brazil.
  • They will be able to supply you with all the 3rd party sourced products (Botox and dermal fillers) and you will leverage your local network to help with the assortment, and you will use your own ground sales network to open up the Brazilian market for my client.
  • Brazil is a good market for this business, as is the wider LATAM region.
  • Maybe you own a beauty clinic, or chain of beauty clinics already in Brazil.
  • Maybe you used to work in Sales for the big global manufactures within medical aesthetics in Brazil and now you are on your own, working as a sales rep, and looking for new products to sell.
  • Maybe your run your own distribution business in Brazil and you have a huge network of beauty salons / clinics - that you already are selling too.
  • You must be fluent in English (written and verbal) to be relevant.


YOU MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE IN BRAZIL SELLING INTO BEAUTY CLINICS / AESTHETIC MEDICINE CLINICS for dermal fillers and injectables only (not prescription medicine).



Responsibilities

  • Someone who will head up the on ground wholesale sales into Brazil in partnership with the the fund - To be relevant for this, you will already either be doing this currently, or have done this very recently in your background
  • You will be selling medical aesthetics like dermal fillers, Botox, injectables directly to any kind of healthcare clinic that uses them. Therefore you MUST have previous experience in selling to small - medium size health care practises who stock similar products.
  • Previous experience in selling to beauty salons, cosmetic GPs and Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons, Aesthetics GPs is essential for success within this capacity
  • This person, or partner, or business, will own the wholesale distribution for the Brazilian market
  • You will leverage your network in Brazil, and detailed product expertise within medical aesthetics, to help determine the price for resale as well as the wider assortment of products needed within the market. Where are the gaps? What are the gaps? You will bring detail expertise to the table here

title: Senior Manager/Director Of Consumer Communications
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


About the Role

The Senior Manager of Consumer Communications - Press & KOLs for Brazil at Keeta will integrate the Communications Team of Keeta and work directly with Keeta´s leadership team in the country to help develop and execute the full Consumer Comms strategy of the company, which is entering the local market focusing on robust expansion and generating strong positive impact in the food delivery industry by bringing new technology and great expertise.

This position reports to the Head of Public Relations in Brazil and requires extensive external Communications experience in innovative and fast-paced companies, preferably in the technology segment. Knowledge and experience in the food, beverage, or food delivery segments is a plus. Experience working with both traditional media and KOLs/social media is also required. Fluent Portuguese and English are required.

The Senior Manager of Consumer Communications - Press & KOLs will be responsible for planning and executing Comms strategies and campaigns in Brazil, interacting directly with media, journalists and KOLs and also managing an external PR agency, in order to:

  • Increase the impact of brand awareness in Brazil.
  • Improve brand favorability.
  • Maintain or improve tonality of earned media stories.
  • Maintain integrated brand campaigns (cross-functional work with Marketing, Social Media, Business, Government Affairs and Internal Comms teams).
  • Manage crisis/mitigate negative PR impact


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

The SE is a highly technical sales professional who is responsible for working with Account Executives (AEs) and Channel Account Managers (CAMs) to drive significant revenue growth within the region.

The Sales Engineer (SE) manages the technical sales process, primarily during the discovery and validation stages of the sales process. The SE is a technical evangelist for our software platform, representing the company with potential customers, partners, and at events.


You are skilled at performing detailed discovery that uncovers the customers’ current state and negative consequences, understanding their desired future state and positive business outcomes, and positioning technical solutions that provide real business value. You can build Proof of Value (PoV) plans that validate the solution is strongly aligned with the customer needs and delivers quantifiable business value. You can smoothly handle objections while remaining focused on the important differentiators. Finally, you can effectively build technical champions inside accounts and operate independently of, but in partnership with your AE and CAM.

You will be expected to quickly come up to speed on our Absolute Secure Endpoint (Visibility, Control, Resilience) and Secure Access product offerings (Absolute VPN, Absolute ZTNA and Absolute Insights for Network). Your deep product knowledge, as well as in-depth knowledge of security, networking, and operating systems will help you to effectively position our products, while also helping to solve difficult technical problems for potential customers during pre-sales presentations, demonstrations, and evaluations.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your Account Executives and Channel Account Managers to establish and execute sales strategy for your territory and key partners
  • Deliver tailored technical sales presentations and demonstrations to prospective customers and partners
  • Plan and execute Proof of Value (PoV, evaluation) activities. This includes scoping the PoV to align with the business pain, defining relevant success criteria and metrics, designing the PoV environment, installing and configuring Absolute Secure Access and Secure Endpoint products, providing technical support to prospective customers, and executing the PoV in accordance with the agreed-upon success criteria
  • Working with your leadership, communicate feature requests and product ideas, backed by data from your sales engagements, into product management. Assist your leadership in working with product management to develop priorities for the company's product roadmap
  • Partnering with your AE and CAM, document the ongoing sales cycles and PoVs in Salesforce.Com
  • Collaborate and education technical peers within Channel partners help uncover new sales opportunities
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

Skills and experience:

  • Experience with complex technical sales cycles, including deep discovery as well as scoping, executing, and presenting complex Proof of Value (evaluations)
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of people, from IT, Network and Security managers to Line of Business owners to CIO and CISOs
  • Understanding of data-in-transit security, including TLS, IPsec, VPNs, PKI, and certificate management
  • Understanding of network services and systems including routing and local and wide area network design Familiar with popular firewall vendors and basic rule design
  • Understanding of authentication methods and protocols including SAML and RADIUS
  • Understanding of AV, EDR, Incident Response, Forensics, or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Familiar with popular firewall vendors and basic rule design
  • Familiar with endpoint security and patch management policies
  • Strong understanding of Windows (Desktop and Server), macOS, and Linux operating systems, including network stacks
  • Can troubleshoot complex network environments to support evaluations on customers’ premise or with the Absolute cloud hosted products
  • Fluent verbal and written communication in English, Spanish and Portuguese

Nice to have:

  • Experience with selling methodologies such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
  • Experience selling SASE, SSE, VPN, EDR, Incident Response or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
  • Experience with Cloud IaaS vendors including networking and security service operation
  • Security (CISSP, GIAC, CompTIA Security+, etc) or networking (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, etc) certifications
  • Experience in IT or Security operations


Why Work For Us:

You’re resilient and passionate about securing the Work from Anywhere era. So are we.

We’re in search of the best and the brightest – everyone from innovators, sellers and marketers to financers, operators and especially customer relationship managers – we’re looking for top tier talent to help us shape the next decade of security, drive innovation that enables customers with truly disruptive solutions and are dedicated to making a meaningful difference.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington with international offices in Vancouver - BC, Austin - TX, Ankeny – IA, Reading - UK and Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam, Absolute Security accelerates customers’ shift to work-from-anywhere through the industry’s first self-healing Zero Trust platform, ensuring maximum security and uncompromised productivity. Only Absolute is embedded in more than half a billion devices, offering a permanent digital connection that intelligently and dynamically applies visibility, control and self-healing capabilities to endpoints, applications, and network access to ensure their cyber resilience tailored for distributed workforces.

Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Absolute currently serves approximately 16,000 customers with more than 13 million activated endpoints globally. title: Ehs Regional Manager
description:
Regional EHS Manager


This position oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of EHS programs across multiple sites in Brazil and Argentina, providing technical and tactical support with the goal of being “best in class” in the introduction and effectiveness of Tenneco EH&S strategies.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Alignment across all plants of the actions required to achieve zero incidents.
  • Ensure all required reporting is updated and accurate in a timely manner
  • Tracking and follow up across all plants to ensure introduction timelines are met and actions closed
  • Identify and correct knowledge gaps within plant teams
  • Facilitate and “read across” of lessons learnt and follow up on the effectiveness at a plant level
  • Develop, implement, and maintain regional EHS policies, procedures, and programs aligned with corporate standards and Brazilian regulations
  • Ensure compliance with relevant Brazilian and local EHS laws, including Regulatory Norm (NR) standards, environmental regulations, and labor health and safety laws
  • Conduct regular site audits, inspections, and risk assessments to identify hazards and enforce corrective actions with the plant team
  • Support the plant thorough incident investigations, root cause analyses, and reporting to prevent recurrence
  • Deliver EHS training and awareness programs specially made to local workforce needs


Minimum Requirements


Education

  • Four (4) year degree in occupational safety, industrial hygiene, environmental discipline or equivalent;
    Relevant advanced degree preferred

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience with an emphasis in environmental, health and safety program management and employee training.

Required skills

  • Must have clear communication and writing skills in English.
  • Proficiency to convey information at multiple levels of the organization
  • Ability to travel a minimum of 50% of the time with up to 75% travel to designated areas.
  • Strong team-building skills
  • Strong organizational skills including ability to manage large number of disparate projects and to track projects through completion
  • Working knowledge of cross-functional EHS disciplines
  • Professional certification preferred (Certified Safety Professional, Certified Industrial Hygienist, Certified Hazardous Materials Manager, or country equivalent).
  • Proficiency in local languages preferred
  • Leadership and Influence
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Mindset
  • Communication Skills
  • Adaptability and Resilience
  • Driving for Results

title: Quality Lead
description:
REGIONAL QUALITY LEAD


The Regional Quality Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality functions and performance for the region.

The Regional Quality Lead will address significant quality-related circumstances and key customer concerns in an effort to improve the overall quality of our production and service. This position will also assess the overall health of the quality environment in all the regional plants, and advise/execute on actions to remedy gaps, weaknesses, and risks in identified plants. This person will also make a significant contribution to improving the overall quality, responsiveness, and reputation.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Address current, significant quality issues in product supplied in their specific region to key customers.
  • Lead problem solving teams.
  • Assess solution effectiveness, and report resolutions to customers.
  • Monitor Quality KPI with the plants.
  • Support on scrap management systems development and improvements.
  • Assess quality systems health.
  • Audit Plants in the region as-needed in order to assess the quality operating systems and gaps to expected levels.
  • Maintain knowledge of customer, international organizations and industry specifics requirements as things change and evolve.
  • Assist with training of quality (and quality impacted) resources in the plants and technology centers.
  • Provide training to specific areas.
  • Communicate actively and effectively with management, Corporate Quality and Senior Leadership, as-needed.
  • Conduct Management reviews of the Quality System as required.


Education :

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, required.
  • Certification in Quality and Program Management is preferred.


Experience :

  • Minimum of four (4) to six (6) years of experience in quality within a manufacturing environment.
  • Proven Experience in an Automotive OE (Original Equipment) setting is a must


Professional Certifications:

  • Relevant ASQ certifications
  • IATF 16949 / ISO 9001, VDA
  • Six Sigma Certifications is strongly a plus


Functional and Technical Competencies:

  • Problem-Solving & Data Analysis
  • Quality Systems & Standards
  • Leadership and Communication
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Fluency in English
  • Availability to travel

  • Prover suporte técnico junto às lojas, monitorando os produtos e respectivas identificações de conteúdo (etiquetas), em atenção aos perecíveis, prazos de validade e armazenamento, orientando as empresas de produtos de higienização e de controle de pragas e produtos de higienização atentando para o atendimento da legislação sanitária e normas internas.

title: Gerente De Negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição para a qual estamos buscando o preenchimento da vaga é de extrema importância estratégica. O Gerente de Negócios tem um papel fundamental na gestão de clientes da carteira, desde a sua entrada. É ele quem acompanha todos os indicadores de resultado do cliente, de forma a medir se os objetivos dele estão sendo cumpridos e o que deve ser feito para promover uma melhoria contínua para isso. Ele é o guardião do resultado que o cliente almeja e que fez com que ele nos contratasse.

O GN é igualmente responsável por potencializar a receita que os clientes que gerencia deixam para a Vertem. Ele deve, a partir do entendimento aprofundado do negócio do cliente, identificar e explorar as oportunidades que existem para a geração de receitas para a Vertem a partir dos produtos e serviços que podemos ofertar para suprir as necessidades identificadas.

A Vertem tem um DNA muito focado no cliente e a unidade em que esta vaga será alocada tem um perfil voltado para a criatividade embarcada ao negócio.

Por tudo isso, a vaga requer um perfil dinâmico, de fácil relacionamento, proativo e ao mesmo tempo, com visão de geração de negócios (comercial).

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Compreender completamente os produtos ou serviços oferecidos pela Vertem, incluindo suas funcionalidades, casos de uso e como eles podem ser adaptados para atender às necessidades específicas dos clientes chave.
  • Gestão de projetos: Planejar, executar e monitorar projetos de implementação ou integração de produtos/serviços para clientes de grande porte, garantindo que suas expectativas sejam atendidas e que os objetivos sejam alcançados dentro do prazo e do orçamento estabelecidos.
  • Rentabilização: Identificar oportunidades de cross sell e upsell nas contas que atende, propondo tanto novos serviços e produtos da Vertem para o cliente, quanto incrementando o volume do que já se tem contratado


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Empatia: Capacidade de compreender as necessidades, preocupações e objetivos dos clientes chave, desenvolvendo relacionamentos sólidos e construindo uma conexão baseada na confiança e na compreensão mútua.
  • Comunicação eficaz: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, concisa e empática, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, garantindo que as informações sejam transmitidas de maneira compreensível e que as expectativas dos clientes sejam gerenciadas de forma adequada.
  • Pensamento estratégico: Capacidade de analisar situações complexas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para cada cliente
  • Para o desempenho do papel de GN, é necessário um bom domínio das ferramentas Office, especialmente Excel, Power BI e Power Point.


  • Vivências anteriores com gestão de clientes e também em áreas comerciais são importantíssimas.

title: Analista De Custos Sênior
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 190 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade



Na posição de Analista de Custos Sênior você será responsável pelo fechamento, acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades de planejamento e análise de custos e despesas das Fabricas e Centros de Distribuição, contribuindo para o atingimento das metas de resultados, dentro dos prazos, padrões de qualidade e ao menor custo possível, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Responsabilidades


  • Analisar os processos de rateio de custos nos Centros de Distribuição por meio da verificação de possíveis distorções, propondo ajustes e adequações;
  • Garantir que asquantidades e valores contidas nos estoques estejam coerentes e de acordo com as movimentações diárias;
  • Garantir a alocação correta dos gastos em contas contábeis e centros de custo, através do acompanhamento das despesas de todas as áreas e Centros de Distribuição do grupo;
  • Apoio a área deContabilidade nas entregas legais de ECF (escrituração contábil e fiscal) e Transfer Price (percentual de malte constante nos produtos acabados), conciliando e confeccionando relatórios suporte;
  • Assegurar o correto fechamento do custo contábil do mix de produtos, mediante a análise da produção do período, das despesas indiretas e das variações dos fatores que impactam diretamente (matéria prima, insumos, mão de obra, materiais, embalagem, gastos com transformação), de forma a obter valorização do estoque e da produção;
  • Disponibilizar o fechamento gerencial do custo do produto para alta gestão, por meio da realização de cálculo ajustado conforme visão de negócio estabelecida para a análise;
  • Garantir o valor do custo standard utilizado nas movimentações de estoque no sistema, através de cálculo considerando as variáveis de gastos fabris, lista técnica, roteiro, preço de insumos e rateios;
  • Efetuar suporteaos colaboradores dos Centros de Distribuição e corporativo, orientando sobre as rotinas da área custo, realizando o atendimento dos chamados oriundos de problemas sistêmicos ou operacionais e chamados de cadastros de materiais.

Controlar prazos, garantir a execução das tratativas e reportar o status à diretoria e à gerência agrícola.

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, department stores and fashion brands across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru and Colombia. How? We have three key products:


1) Flexifleet: Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.


2) Fulfillment Optimizer: Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing and delivery.


3) Consumer Connect: AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.


We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability. Backed by over $70M USD in venture capital, we’ve delivered consistent growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across our network. And this is just the beginning. We're building a profitable, scalable ecosystem — and our vision is to become the #1 partner for retailers to grow their eCommerce business.

title: Solutions Consultant - Latam
description:
Lead Solutions Consultant - LATAM | São Paulo, Brazil


Are you a passionate and driven solutions architect with a knack for understanding complex client needs and crafting compelling solutions?

  • Represent Netcore at industry events, conferences, and meetups across the LATAM region, building brand awareness and thought leadership.


What We Look For:


  • Strong ownership mentality , demonstrating discipline, focus, and unwavering commitment to customer success.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and proven ability to navigate and overcome objections effectively.
  • Adept at creating impactful and innovative demonstrations that resonate with clients and clearly articulate value, leveraging available content and tools.
  • Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in sales engineering or pre-sales within the MarTech industry .
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills in both technical and business contexts, with fluency in Portuguese and English being essential. Spanish language proficiency is highly desirable.
  • This role is based in Brazil and requires flexibility to travel across the LATAM region for in-person meetings with key accounts.
  • A genuine passion for continuous learning , staying abreast of new MarTech tools and evolving market trends within Latin America.
  • Proven ability to support clients with complex MarTech needs , demonstrating a deep understanding of marketing automation, personalization, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Capacity to effectively support multiple Sales Leaders operating within the LATAM markets.
  • Deep expertise in the MarTech landscape and a strong understanding of SaaS solutions.
  • Proven ability to craft impactful product demos that clearly showcase value to clients.
  • Experience in contributing to or developing sales engineering playbooks and best practices.

We proudly partner with over 8500+ enterprise brands across 18 countries and serve more than 70% of India's Unicorns, establishing us as a top-tier personalization marketing platform.


Headquartered in India, our global presence extends across 18 countries. Netcore has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years, underscoring our people-first culture rooted in the values of honesty, humanity, openness, and a deep commitment to the success of both our customers and employees.


Embarking on a career at Netcore transcends a typical job – it's an opportunity to shape the future of MarTech. For further information, we invite you to visit netcorecloud.Com or connect with us on LinkedIn.


Your Success:


  • Experience significant growth through experimentation on product-market fit within the LATAM region, collaborating closely with all functions to drive success in specific customer segments and verticals.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Analyst
description:
About the Role:


This position is ideal for a compliance professional with a strong background in Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing regulations, especially within the Brazilian market. The role involves working in a fast-paced, regulated environment, providing critical support to uphold the integrity of the company’s compliance program. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in monitoring financial activity, investigating suspicious behavior, and ensuring regulatory obligations are met through collaboration with internal teams and regulatory bodies.


Main Responsibilities:


  • Investigate transaction monitoring alerts to identify unusual or suspicious activity.
  • Conduct Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), along with risk assessments for clients.
  • Validate and verify client documentation and Know Your Customer (KYC) data.
  • Ensure all AML/CFT policies and procedures are properly followed and documented to demonstrate compliance with Brazilian regulations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement AML/CFT procedures effectively across the business.
  • Coordinate compliance initiatives related to new products, services, and internal operational processes.
  • Monitor changes in Brazilian AML/CFT legislation and ensure ongoing alignment with regulatory expectations.
  • Prepare and escalate Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) to the MLRO and maintain supporting documentation.
  • Participate in audits and liaise with both internal and external auditors as needed.
  • Assist with regulatory reporting obligations and ensure timely submissions to relevant authorities.
  • Support crisis management and incident response efforts involving compliance violations.
  • Deliver or contribute to AML/CFT training programs for internal teams.
  • Address internal inquiries related to compliance procedures and AML/CFT standards.
  • Continuously improve transaction monitoring rules and other AML triggers.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of the AML/CFT program.


Desired Experience:


A minimum of 4 years’ experience in compliance, AML/CFT, or audit within a regulated environment.

Strong command of English, both written and spoken.

Practical knowledge of the Brazilian AML/CFT regulatory landscape and experience applying it in a corporate setting.

Experience preparing documentation for audits and regulatory reporting.

Proficient in using tools like Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Drive), Slack, Airtable, and Intercom.

Experience interacting with auditors or regulators is a plus.

Knowledge of the sports betting or online gambling industry is considered beneficial

Highly analytical, detail-focused, and capable of working proactively and independently.

Aqui, evitamos soluções de terceiros: construímos todos os nossos sistemas in-house, com o objetivo de criar soluções inteligentes para automatizar o abastecimento da casa dos nossos clientes. Enfrentamos desafios logísticos complexos — ótimos problemas de programação, que exigem criatividade, estrutura, visão de arquitetura e foco em performance.


Valorizamos pessoas que estejam dispostas a estar presentes com o time — no código, nas decisões e também no escritório. title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: On-Site IT Support Engineer

Location : Sao paulo Brazil (Onsite)

Duration : 3 months Contract (extendable)


Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.


Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.


Qualifications:


  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

title: Data Analyst (Azure)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field.
  • Skilled in quantitative research and statistical modeling for delivering insights.
  • Proficient in complex SQL queries and stored procedures with attention to detail.
  • Experienced in Client Relationship Management and multitasking in fast-paced environments.
  • 4-5 years' hands-on experience in Report Development and Data Analysis.
  • Experience working with Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Familiarity with GitHub and Visual Studios SSIS/SSRS for code management and reporting.
  • Proficient in Python for data manipulation, with knowledge of PowerBI/Qlik.
  • Expertise in entire quantitative research process and statistical methods.
  • Ability to communicate data-driven stories effectively and achieve business outcomes.
  • Understanding of software development best practices and cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills in English are required to work effectively with our US-based clients.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Understand business requirements, determine relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and prepare visualization reports.
  • Gathering data from various sources like databases, APIs, files, and streams, and ensuring its integration into a suitable format for analysis.
  • Preparing the data for analysis by addressing inconsistencies, errors, and missing values to ensure its quality and reliability.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Implementing and maintaining data governance policies and security measures to safeguard sensitive information and ensure compliance with regulations.
  • Employing statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms to analyze data, identify patterns, trends, and insights, and develop predictive models for forecasting.


Qualifications

Tableau, Power BI and Qlik


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Analista De Parcerias E Eventos
description:
Nesta posição, a pessoa escolhida terá um papel essencial no fortalecimento do canal de Diálogo Direto, liderando a participação do Greenpeace em eventos, festivais e espaços estratégicos, além de desenvolver parcerias que ampliem o alcance da nossa base de doadores/as.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

● Definir estratégias para aquisição de novos doadores individuais em eventos, sempre alinhados aos valores da organização;

● Monitorar resultados e propor melhorias para indicadores como número de doadores/as, receita, ticket médio e retenção;

● Prospectar e negociar eventos e parcerias corporativas, elaborando propostas comerciais e prestações de contas;

● Negociar contratos e gerir fornecedores, respeitando as diretrizes jurídicas e financeiras;

● Coordenar questões logísticas, como credenciamento, montagem de stands e contrapartidas contratuais;

● Contribuir com o planejamento anual da área e apoiar treinamentos e ações de engajamento interno;

● Assegurar o usoresponsável dos recursos, documentação de processos e alinhamento com os valores do Greenpeace.

QUALIFICAÇÕES OBRIGATÓRIAS:

● Olhar estratégico e orientação para dados na tomada de decisões;

● Capacidade de persuasão, influência e motivação;

● Perfil proativo, dinâmico, resiliente e comprometido;

● Conhecimento intermediário em Excel;

● Disponibilidadepara viagens e/ou eventos fora do horário comercial.

QUALIFICAÇÕES DESEJÁVEIS:

● Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH), categoria B;

● Ensino superiorcompleto;

● Inglês intermediário;

● Experiência comprospecção de eventos e/ou parcerias corporativas (B2B).
